commitSubject: The GUI-106 flake cure the red release battery named by hand: the FTPS row's leg-4 real click starved its whole 20s actionability window on a listing that leg 3's refresh polls had left landing over it — the row was present (both leg screenshots prove the seat), the click, not the finder, timed out, the WebDAVS sibling passed the same grammar 30s later, and the row was green this morning on identical runtime code.
